Board of Directors Meeting
                           Wednesday, October 14, 2026, 4:00 p.m.
                         Tahoe Blue Event Center, LTVA Conference Room
                                         75 US-50, Stateline, Nevada

                                          Public Attendance Options:

1. Attend the meeting in person at the address indicated above.
2. To view this meeting on Zoom, visit
https://us06web.zoom.us/j/83256256005?pwd=G6xaSk4bxjDmB0PKOp7qwQ3SyzpuOo.1
Meeting ID: 832 5625 6005 Passcode: 629877
3. To listen to this Zoom meeting, dial 1-669-900-6833 and enter the Webinar ID when prompted.

                                                Public Comment:
Public comments will be accepted at the beginning and end of the meeting. Public comment can also be made prior to
the meeting by emailing info@tahoedouglasva.org. Any person wishing to make a public comment may do so in person
at the Board meeting, virtually by use of the chat feature, or by emailing comments to info@tahoedouglasva.org.

The Board reserves the right to take items in a different order to accomplish business in the most efficient manner,
to combine two or more agenda items for consideration, and to remove items from the agenda or delay discussion
relating to items on the agenda.


                                                     AGENDA

   1. Call to Order and Pledge of Allegiance
   2. Roll Call
   3. Introduction of Guests and Staff
   4. Public Comment on Non-Agenda Items: Limit three (3) minutes per person. No action may be taken.
   5. Approval of Agenda
   6. Approval of Board Meeting Minutes: September 9, 2026
   7. Approval of Special Board Meeting Minutes: September 21, 2026
   8. Possible Action: July 2026 Financial Statements – Katharine Nastasia
   9. Review and Discuss: August 2026 Preliminary Financial Statements – Katharine Nastasia
   10. Tahoe Blue Event Center Quarterly Update (July 2026 – September 2026) – Kevin Boryczki
   11. Possible Action: Item Request to Transfer $128,575 to Cover FY25 Operating Deficit – Kevin Boryczki

12. Update: Event Center Update and Monthly Report – Rick Kozuback of International Coliseums Company; Lewis
       Feldman of Feldman Thiel LLP; Kevin Boryczki of OVG360

   13. Update: LTVA Historical Performance/SLTTID Special Meeting – Carol Chaplin
   14. Recommendation for Future Agenda Items
   15. Updates by Board Members and Staff:

        This is an opportunity for Board members and staff to present updates on meetings they have attended,
        legislative matters, or other items that are relevant to the mission of the Tahoe Douglas Visitors Authority.
        There will be no action taken on these items other than to possibly request that items be placed on future
        agendas or to direct staff to further investigate the matter.

   16. Public Comment: Limit three (3) minutes per person. No action may be taken.
   17. Next Meeting: Wednesday, November 11, 2026, at 4:00 p.m.
   18. Adjournment


NOTE: We are pleased to make accommodations for members of the public who are differently abled. Please notify the TDVA in
writing at PO Box 6777, Stateline, NV 89449 or call (775) 589-2052 prior to the meeting. In accordance with Nevada Revised Statute
Chapter 241, this agenda closes three days prior to the meeting day and notice of the meeting and its supporting documentation
was posted on www.LTVA.org, www.tahoedouglasva.org, and the NV State posting website at notice.nv.gov. Notice of this meeting
was faxed and emailed for posting to the following locations: Douglas County Library, Minden Branch, 1625 Library Lane, Minden,
NV; City of South Lake Tahoe, CA City Offices, 1901 Lisa Maloff Way, South Lake Tahoe, CA; El Dorado County Library, South Lake
Tahoe Branch, 1000 Rufus Allen Blvd, South Lake Tahoe, CA; Kahle Community Center, 236 Kingsbury Grade Rd, Stateline, Nevada.
